abstract: Run open-weight LLMs on a personal laptop or desktop (macOS on Apple Silicon, Windows, Linux) with Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp (llama-server) or MLX (mlx-lm). The skill discovers hardware and installed runtimes first, picks the native accelerator path (Metal/MLX, CUDA, ROCm/Vulkan), sizes weights plus KV cache against VRAM or unified memory, serves an OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoint on localhost, and covers secure LAN sharing (SSH, Tailscale Serve, API keys, firewall), fixed-protocol benchmarking with scripts/bench.sh, updates, disk cleanup and troubleshooting.
